item.title: Moving into this house as a single mum was the biggest leap I've ever taken
item.description: Moving into this house as a single mum was the biggest leap I've ever taken and I honestly never thought never thought I would be able to buy my own home, but here I am. I can honestly say this has been the best year of my life and I am so proud of everything I have done but also how much I have healed and grown as a person. Here's a look at the before and afters so far... #singlemumlife #singlemum #lifeafterdivorce #newbeginnings

item.title: We can be heartbroken and still rebuild
item.description: After opening up about my journey as a single mum and rebuilding my life after betrayal, I honestly didn't expect how many of you would come back and say “me too”. That connection has meant more than I can put into words. It’s so easy to believe the idea that single mums are just struggling and barely holding it all together, but that isn't the whole story. We can be heartbroken and still rebuild. We can have hard days and still create something beautiful for our children and for ourselves. And knowing so many of you are doing the same makes it all feel a little less lonely. �� #singlemum #singlemumlife #lifeafterdivorce #girlpower
